review_text: The cotton feels soft but the shoulder seam pulls when I lift my arms; a slightly wider shoulder panel would improve comfort.
The waistband feels tight after sitting for 20 minutes and the left pocket opening is difficult to reach. I recommend more room at the waist.
Great color and nice overall fit.
The sleeves extend around 3 cm beyond my wrists and the zipper catches at the lower hem; shortening the sleeves could improve the fit.
Not comfortable and I do not like it.
The fabric is breathable during walking but the waist stitching scratches the skin. A softer seam finish would be helpful.
The neck opening remains comfortable after a wash, although the hem became shorter by roughly 1 cm; I would check shrinkage before changing the design.
The fit is excellent and the inner fabric stays soft during a long walk. The pocket opening is narrow for my phone; consider widening it.
The shoulder fit is loose but the sleeve cuff is tight, which reduces comfort while working. A wider cuff may help.
The fabric is light and comfortable. I noticed the button placement leaves a gap at the chest when sitting; an extra button could help.
Waist and length are both true to size, but the inner seam rubs against my knee during movement. Softer stitching could reduce irritation.
Looks good in pictures but the collar rubs my neck and the lining traps heat during a short walk; a breathable inner layer might improve comfort.
